original_card.question: Can one exact all-size/compiler, precision, hosting or restoration implication be proved or falsified?
methods: Prove one missing implication with explicit quantified hypotheses.
Find an exact counterexample at the claimed interface boundary.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Identify the proposition and what would change downstream; do not equate a finite replay with a universal proof.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected review scope and choose one exact all-size or precision implication.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write its quantified inputs and conclusion; find a missing hypothesis or construct a minimal exact adversarial instance.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Finite supplier improvements are useful only under the retained transfer obligations.
allowed_variations: Choose one tape, precision, hosting or restoration lemma.
scope_change_triggers: Replacing a quantified obligation with another finite smoke test.

actual_scope: All-size exact maximum E(n) of transport of one unit error injected at the destination of a completed leaf of PR628's balanced reserved-depth dirty word (free noncommuting contractive factors, both orientations, every later cut, every register): E(n) = max(1, floor(log2 n)) for every n >= 1.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for one exact all-size implication. This takes the open quantified question recorded by research/leaf-destination-transport (finite n<=32 census) and PR1416's single-register-interval-transport (exact maximum between h-1 and h+2), and settles it for destination-supported single errors by a written induction. Finite exact checks corroborate the lemmas; they are not offered as the proof.
bottleneck_link: Rounding errors enter at specific leaf destinations; a sharp all-size destination-supported transport constant replaces the h+2 single-register bound in precision accounting for that error class. No kappa or precision-invoice change is claimed.
stop_rule: Stop at a written all-size upper bound plus an explicit attaining family, exact finite checks of each lemma and mutation controls; do not extend to multiple or accumulated errors, internal leaf values, rounding or aliasing.
evidence: PROOF.md (Theorems 1-2 with Lemmas S, L2, L1, I, X, P). verify.py: PR628 compose word equality n<=40; check2 all lemma/case/E checks n=1..40 and family n<=128; family closed form n=2..200; Lemmas L1/L2/S n<=32; independent census n<=24; unreversed-inverse and ceil-half-split mutation controls rejected. Author logs: check2 n=1..80, family/closed form n<=512, census n<=128 (logs/).
author: Philippe Van Velzen, with substantial Claude (Anthropic) assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial Claude (Anthropic) assistance: the proof, census and checking scripts were written by Claude sub-agents; the main session re-ran the checks. No independent human review and no formal (Lean) proof.

open_questions.question: What is the exact maximum transport of multiple or accumulated destination errors (one per leaf, or per phase) in the same word?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A precision invoice sums rounding errors over all leaves; the single-error constant does not bound their joint growth, and the arbitrary joint-register bound is quadratic.
open_questions.first_step: Inject one unit error at every completed-leaf destination of one call and track the column through Lemma X's exit-support count, starting at n<=16.
open_questions.blocked_by: Lemma L1's one-term-per-entry argument fails for superposed injections; open PR2067 treats endpoint accumulation only.

open_questions.question: Is the lower bound attained, with a written proof, in the three source-dirty LCA cases other than (U,V) with sign +?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Theorem 2 needs only one attaining case, but the exact per-case values describe where precision headroom is spent and are currently census-only (m<=80).
open_questions.first_step: Find a sign-minus analogue of Lemma P, or a different readout cut, for the (U,V') sign-minus case.
open_questions.blocked_by: Lemma P fails for sign minus: V' cancels the A z contribution that V adds to row y.
